title: Domain F Constraint Analysis
methodology: Function constructor parse of all 5 pack files. Section F state distribution across packs.

packC_sectionF.note: ALL 75 items unprocessed. Never seen any audit. Section F in Pack C is a greenfield.

packD_sectionF.note: 74 unprocessed. Note: FD-046 is the single missing item (archived per CURRENT_BASELINES).

bottleneckDiagnosis.primaryBottleneck: GREENFIELD — unlike Domain E (77% archived clones), Domain F is nearly all unprocessed (149/149 = 100%). No clone rotation artifacts. No archived items to rescue. Pure content-authoring challenge: author 149 new Section F items and certify them from scratch.
bottleneckDiagnosis.structuralVsContent: CONTENT bottleneck, not structural. Domain F items don't exist in Packs C/D Section F — they need to be AUTHORED, not repaired.
bottleneckDiagnosis.ewSituation: 130 EW debt items per S307 — but these are on the 225 certified items (Pack A/B/E). The 149 unprocessed items will need EW as part of creation.

dependencyValidation.s308_claim: Domain E must precede Domain F
dependencyValidation.analysis: PARTIALLY CORRECT. Domain E Section E items are archived clones needing repair. Domain F Section F items are greenfield needing authoring. They touch DIFFERENT sections in the same pack files. They CAN run partially parallel as long as: (1) Pack C Sections E and F are not modified in the same session, (2) Pack D Sections E and F are not modified in the same session.
dependencyValidation.parallelizationStrategy: Session A: Pack C Section E certification. Session B: Pack D Section F authoring (parallel, different files). Session C: Pack D Section E certification. Session D: Pack C Section F authoring (parallel, different files). This achieves 2x throughput on the critical bottleneck path.
dependencyValidation.strictlySequentialPortion: The first 2 sessions must establish the certification methodology for Domain E before it can be replicated for Domain F. After methodology is established, remaining sessions can parallelize.

highestLeverageAction: AUTHOR Pack C/D Section F items as NEW items (not repairs). Use Pack B Section F (75 certified items) as the quality benchmark template. Author 149 new Technology & Analytics items using the 800-series certification pipeline.

savingsLevers: Greenfield authoring is faster than clone repair (no re-rotation needed)
Parallel E/F certification after methodology baseline (sessions 3+)
Batch EW  authoring as part of item creation
